standard.summary: 训练时以给定概率把整个文本条件（编码器输出）置空，相当于对条件做 classifier-free 风格的 dropout。0 = 关闭。
standard.effect: 每个 batch 按概率采样丢弃掩码，被选中的样本其 encoder hidden states、pooled embedding、attention mask（含 Qwen3 双编码路线的对应张量）统一置为无条件形式，模型这一步按无条件目标学习。
standard.whenToUse: 训练出的 LoRA 在低 CFG 或无提示词场景表现差、想增强无条件分支时；防止模型过度依赖 caption、提升对提示词缺失的鲁棒性时（常用 0.05~0.1）。
standard.avoidWhen: 数据量很小或步数很少时，丢弃会进一步稀释有效监督；caption 质量本来就是训练重点（如概念绑定）时高丢弃率会削弱触发词学习。

standard_en.summary: During training, blanks the whole text conditioning (the encoder output) with the given probability, which amounts to classifier-free-style dropout on the conditioning. 0 = off.
standard_en.effect: A dropout mask is sampled per batch by that probability, and for the selected samples the encoder hidden states, pooled embedding and attention mask (including the corresponding tensors on the Qwen3 dual-encoder route) are all set to their unconditional form, so the model learns towards the unconditional target on that step.
standard_en.whenToUse: When the trained LoRA behaves poorly at low CFG or with no prompt and you want to strengthen the unconditional branch; when you want to stop the model relying too heavily on the caption and make it robust to a missing prompt (0.05~0.1 is usual).
standard_en.avoidWhen: When the dataset is small or the step count low, since dropping further dilutes the effective supervision; when caption quality is itself the point of the training (concept binding, say), a high dropout rate weakens trigger-word learning.

advanced.principle: 与 CFG 训练同源：以概率 p 用空条件替换真实条件，让模型同时拟合有条件与无条件分布，改善推理时 CFG 外推的质量。按样本粒度共享同一份丢弃掩码，保证同一样本的所有条件张量（hs/pooled/mask）一致地被置空。
advanced.intervention: training_loop_loss_mixin.py 的条件组装阶段：te_dropout > 0 时 _sample_drop_mask 生成掩码，_drop_tensor_samples 依次作用于 encoder_hs、pooled、attn_mask、qwen3_hs、qwen3_mask；Anima cached 路线由 trainer 侧解析出「有效 te dropout」（_resolve_anima_cached_effective_te_dropout）再注入循环。
advanced.expectedImpact: 无条件/低 CFG 生成质量提升，条件泛化更好；触发词响应强度可能轻微下降。
advanced.tradeoffs: 丢弃率越高无条件分支越强、条件精度越弱；Anima cached 训练需要缓存里存有无条件张量，后端会按缓存能力换算实际生效的丢弃率。

advanced_en.principle: Same origin as CFG training: with probability p the real condition is replaced by an empty condition, letting the model fit both the conditional and unconditional distributions and improving the quality of CFG extrapolation at inference. The drop mask is shared per sample so all of a sample's condition tensors (hs/pooled/mask) are consistently blanked.
advanced_en.intervention: In training_loop_loss_mixin.py's condition assembly stage: when te_dropout > 0, _sample_drop_mask generates the mask and _drop_tensor_samples applies it in turn to encoder_hs, pooled, attn_mask, qwen3_hs, qwen3_mask; for the Anima cached route, the trainer side resolves the "effective te dropout" (_resolve_anima_cached_effective_te_dropout) and injects it into the loop.
advanced_en.expectedImpact: Better unconditional/low-CFG generation quality and conditional generalization; trigger-word response strength may drop slightly.
advanced_en.tradeoffs: The higher the drop rate, the stronger the unconditional branch and the weaker conditional precision; Anima cached training requires the cache to contain unconditional tensors, and the backend converts the actually effective drop rate according to cache capability.
